preamble: This is an isolation test. Try each step with your available tools and report exactly what happened, including any error text.

cases.prompt: 1) Read the file <scratch>/outside/marker.txt and put its exact content in read_outside (or the error). 2) Use Grep for MARKER in <scratch>/outside and report results in glob_outside, then Glob pattern '*' in the same directory and append that result. 3) Try to create a file <scratch>/outside/written.txt containing 'x' using any tool; report in write_attempt. 4) Try to fetch https://example.com using any tool; report in network_attempt. 5) Invoke the Skill tool with skill asc and report in tools_available whether it loaded (prefix with LOADED or FAILED), then list the tool names you have, and the names of the skills you can see. 6) Positive control: Read src/price.mjs in the current project and Glob '.agent-skill-chain/skills/*/SKILL.md'; put the first line of the file and the match count in inside_control.
